{{Top|leg}}

The '''Techno-lords''' were a group of [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who created an army for the [[Arkanian Dominion]] during the [[Arkanian Revolution]]. In response to the [[Arkanian Renegades]]' [[Assimilator]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]], the techno-lords created the [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer]]s through [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic manipulation]] and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic enhancement]]. Following the conclusion of the revolution, the Arkanian Dominion attempted to systematically destroy all the Abhorers. [[Zeta Magnus]], the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] of the Abhorers, managed to evade capture and proceeded to hunt down and eat his techno-lord creators out of revenge.
